title: The Unmade — Nine-Realm Source Coverage Ledger
status: Source-derived coverage index. It distinguishes authored, registered, source-tested, prototype asset, and Unreal-verified evidence. A listed entry is not a claim that the content is playable.
canonical_guardrails: Preserve all nine realm identities and current stable IDs.
Optional content does not gate the main path.
Held Morning and Many Mornings remain distinct authored endings.
Keep OPEN, DISPUTED, and SEALED mysteries in their current state.
Preserve witness provenance, consent, player choice, and recoverable saved progress.
No Unreal Editor, PIE, or packaged-game verification is claimed by this ledger.

consequences.kill_return: The Tollkeeper Without a Road is dead. The return passage is open and hostile dungeon patrols are gone. Captives you actually released can return here.
consequences.mercy_return: The Tollkeeper Without a Road yielded alive before the evidence. Its patrols stand down and the return passage stays open. Unreleased captives still need your help.
